hero.title: Artificial intelligence for food safety
hero.lead: 12 AI services in one portal. Certificates, import and export, laboratory, market oversight and forecasts for farmers. From farm to table.

services.title: 12 artificial intelligence services
services.lead: Every service runs on official data. A specialist makes the final decision.

tech.title: Four core technologies
tech.lead: All 12 services run on these four technologies.

items.title: Language model
items.text: Answers questions in Uzbek based on laws and regulations.

items.title: Computer vision
items.text: Understands photos and video: labels, pests, kitchen cameras.

items.title: Speech to text
items.text: Records calls to 1288 and turns them into text.

items.title: Model platform
items.text: All models are trained, tested and deployed in one place.

journey.title: Farm to table — 4 stages
journey.lead: AI helps at every stage of a product's journey. Scroll down and the path opens step by step.

stages.title: The farmer knows before the pests arrive
stages.text: Trap and weather data are analysed. The warning reaches the farmer 5–7 days ahead.
stages.imageAlt: A cotton and wheat field with a pheromone trap and a weather station

stages.title: Samples are tested and checked against requirements
stages.text: The system checks whether pesticide residue is within limits. Results are checked in advance against the destination country's rules.
stages.imageAlt: A lab bench with a flask, test tubes and a microscope

stages.title: One colour per shipment: green, yellow, red
stages.text: Safe cargo clears fast. Suspicious cargo is inspected. Inspectors spend their time where the risk is.
stages.imageAlt: A truck at a border checkpoint with a traffic light

stages.title: Dangerous products come off the shelf fast
stages.text: Labels are checked from a photo. When an international alert arrives, the recall signal goes out the same day.
stages.imageAlt: A market stall and a phone scanning a QR code on a product
